scope: Same 140 previously inspected cue cases through 256 us, at three timesteps and three predeclared equal-dimension observation panels; streamed CPU/L4 qualification and descriptive reader outcomes.
purpose: Test whether longer observation makes remote location/timing contrasts readable without stronger cues, more features or a lower reader margin; check timestep sensitivity and preserve the original 64-us result.

reader.calibration: Fit the inherited three-strength polyline separately for every arm, observation panel and integration step; also report curves frozen at 0.25 us for voltage, final-voltage and all-cell modes.
reader.features: Every primary panel contains exactly 15 area-weighted voltages from unstimulated cells 2,3,5,6,7, in time-first order. All-cell comparators contain 21 values and never enter primary calibration.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

primary: long256, resolution-matched calibration, dt=0.0625 us, 15 unstimulated-cell voltage features; report both correct-and-resolved labels in all 16 joint cases and finest-step score/decision stability. Other panels and modes are comparisons, not substitutes.
panel: Reuse all 140 rows and physical world identities from the frozen unstimulated assay, including all five arms and seven strengths. This is a controlled extension of inspected cases, not fresh holdout or independent biological replication.
fixed_cues: Sources 1 and 4; 75/25 or reversed location shares; equal timing-only shares; same area-integrated 8-us inhibition dose. Location-only pulse at 16-24 us, other cued arms at 8-16 or 24-32 us. All cue controls return to baseline after 32 us and remain there through 256 us.

contrast.definition: Label 1 minus label 0 area-weighted voltage, paired at fixed arm, other label and cue strength; 15 unstimulated-cell features in each predeclared observation panel
contrast.criteria_rationale: The absolute stability limit uses the original synthetic reader margin; the signal floor is twice that margin. The 10% limit requires small relative change as well. These are declared numerical diagnostics, not measured sensor precision or a continuum error bound.
contrast.stable_at_finest_steps: The 0.125-to-0.0625-us contrast change must satisfy BOTH the inherited 2-nV absolute and 10% relative limits. Separately report the signal floor and whether the 0.25-us contrast meets the same limits against 0.0625 us.
contrast.order_resolution: For each coordinate, a difference of two paired contrasts uses four inherited voltage comparison allowances: 4*atol + 2*rtol*(max_abs_early + max_abs_late). The two successive L2 changes must each exceed five times its L2 norm before interpreting their ratio as resolved first-order refinement. This comparison allowance is not a statistical noise estimate.

contrasts: For both labels, pair opposite labels at fixed arm, strength and other label. Report all pairs, including redundant single-task controls; they are not independent samples. Compare all three timestep contrasts using the inherited thresholds.
historical_reproduction: Compare all 140 finest-step first windows against authenticated complete 64-us trajectories under unchanged physical tolerances; report bitwise equality, reader score/decision differences and shuffle agreement explicitly. Historical evidence and outcomes remain frozen.
storage: Write complete 14-array state histories and sampled fields per world/window; retain only the current batch window and compact readout vectors. Compare CPU/L4 and changed-window replay by reading archive segments. Per-world inputs and completed windows remain durable on failure.
scope_exclusions: No production-source, numerical-law, physical-tolerance, cue-dose, pulse-time, tissue-geometry, initial-state, strength-panel, decoder-algorithm or margin changes.
Observation panels and primary endpoint are fixed before new responses are simulated; no feature search, response-driven endpoint selection, threshold tuning or label/strength input to prediction.

Only calibration rows fit readers; every observation panel has three times and identical feature count. Recalibration across horizons is explicit; frozen-coarse comparisons expose timestep-dependent calibration shifts.

Scientific failures, unresolved signals and decision/stability changes are retained as outcomes, not reasons to fail valid numerical execution. Three finite timesteps provide diagnostics, not a continuum bound.

Disconnected junctions retain extracellular/electrical routes; remote decoding alone does not establish junction necessity or causal biological consumers, polycomputing, memory, reconstruction or heredity.
No new native mixed pump/channel/junction-event correspondence or biological calibration claim; this is a synthetic assay on the qualified ordinary runtime.

Every arm executes the same world-step budget at each resolution. Track GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage; compilation and host work are included, with no utilization gate or Jupiter throughput claim.
Nonintegrating controls/resource checks and synthetic known answers precede frozen launch; no new scientific responses are inspected during development.
